item.title: Diamond Wipes International Recalls MD Wipe Outz Numbing Tattoo Wipes Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging
item.company: Diamond Wipes International, Inc., of Chino, California
item.brand: Diamond Wipes International, Inc., of Chino, California
item.product: MD Wipe Outz Numbing Tattoo Wipes
item.summary: This recall involves MD Wipe Outz Numbing Tattoo Wipes. The pain-relieving wipes were sold in individually wrapped 3 x 4 inches foil packets in boxes of 5, 10, 25, and 250. The Wipe Outz logo, “NUMB” and “Lidocaine Infused” is printed on the front of the packet.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: MD Wipe Outz Numbing Tattoo Wipes.
item.remedy: Consumers should secure the wipes out of sight and reach of children immediately and contact Diamond Wipes for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to write “RECALLED” on the packet and send a photo of the marked packet to recall@diamondwipes.com. Consumers should then dispose of the packets.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
